notes: Window redesign, step 2 of 4: the show page. Only Play and Play on TV are buttons now; everything else (Mark all watched, MyAnimeList, Trailer, Wrong match?, Add to collection, Your own info, Open folder, Move or rename) is in a More menu. Tracking, Lock and saved info, On the TV, Opening and ending, From your Plex library and Episodes are sections you can fold; a closed section shows one line with what matters (your list entry and how far it is behind, the lock state, what plays on which TV), and AniBox remembers which ones you keep open. The episode list is tighter, marks the next episode (Up next / Resume at) and shows lengths where known. Nothing about how AniBox works changed.
